dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is this machine so powerful?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I can't even hit the thing!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: No, you guys, don't attack him! We just have to wait it out!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I'm not letting Krum-Clank become a war machine!
